_doc: Retro skin end-level backdrop (epic tg-wtv: phosphor green on near-black). The user's hand-drawn 2012 robots (set retro-legacy) stand on it, about 30 of them, so the bottom half must be an open ground plane. Generated at 512x384 and scaled x2 nearest to 1024x768 (the end-level landscape size). Placement of the robots: tools/art/retro-freed-layout.mjs. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

shared.city: Subject: a night-time city horizon behind a game's victory screen. The top third is a black night sky with a few tiny green star pixels and a thin green crescent moon on the upper right. Just above the middle, a long low city skyline runs along the whole horizon: flat rectangular buildings and towers of different heights, dark silhouettes with thin glowing green outlines and a few dim green window dots, one or two antenna masts. From the horizon down to the bottom edge, one wide flat empty ground plane: a dark floor covered by a dim glowing green perspective grid of thin lines receding to the horizon, with nothing standing on it.
shared.hills: Subject: a night-time landscape horizon behind a game's victory screen. The top third is a black night sky with a few tiny green star pixels and a thin green crescent moon on the upper left. Just above the middle, far rolling hills and low mountains drawn as thin glowing green contour lines on black, with a tiny distant city of dim green lights in a valley in the centre. From the horizon down to the bottom edge, one wide flat empty plain: a dark floor covered by a dim glowing green perspective grid of thin lines receding to the horizon, with nothing standing on it.
shared.cityPlain: Subject: a night-time city horizon behind a game's victory screen. The top third is a black night sky with a few tiny green star pixels. Just above the middle, a long low city skyline runs along the whole horizon: flat rectangular buildings and towers of different heights, dark silhouettes with thin glowing green outlines and a few dim green window dots. From the horizon down to the bottom edge, one wide flat empty open ground: a very dark green floor with sparse dim green dither dots and a few faint horizontal lines that get closer together near the horizon, with nothing standing on it.
